script: Decision: covered. The claimant reports shattered side-window glass, corroborated by the image, consistent with glass breakage covered under the purchased other-than-collision coverage. Nothing supplied indicates collision or an intentional act by the insured or a family member; the unknown actor alone does not establish an exclusion. Next action: Process the glass loss under other-than-collision coverage, subject to the applicable limit and declarations deductible.
